ios.desc:
The #1 golf GPS app and rangefinder trusted by 5M+ golfers worldwide. Hole19 delivers pinpoint accurate yardages, AI-powered shot tracking, a digital scorecard, and a handicap tracker, all on your iPhone and Apple Watch.

Whether you're chasing your first sub-90 or defending single digits, Hole19 has the tools to lower your score. Coverage of 42,000+ courses in 201 countries, a full-featured Apple Watch integration, and features built with 10+ years of real golfer feedback.

Golfers who track their shots with Hole19 Premium save an average of 3 shots per round. Try Premium free for 14 days.

FREE FEATURES:
- Golf GPS Rangefinder: Pinpoint distances to the front, center, and back of the green plus every hazard and target across 42,000+ courses.
- Digital Scorecard: Scores, putts, fairways hit, and GIR tracked on your phone or Apple Watch.
- Course Preview: Explore every hole layout and hazard before you tee off.
- Apple Watch GPS: Front, center, back distances on your wrist. Phone-free play.
- LivePlay: Organize rounds, track live leaderboards, and share the round in real time.
- Golf Social Network: Connect with golfers worldwide, share scores and course photos.
- Siri Voice Commands (iOS): Start a round hands-free.
- Monthly Challenges: Compete for prizes.

PREMIUM FEATURES:
- Plays Like Distances: Real yardages adjusted for elevation.
- Shot Tracker: Track every shot and see exactly where it landed.
- Club Recommendation: Personalized club suggestions based on your actual distances.
- Augmented Reality (iOS): Distances and directions overlaid on your camera view.
- Handicap Calculator: Global-standard handicap index with improvement tracking.
- Club & Overall Stats: Driving accuracy, greens in regulation, short game, putting.
- Apple Watch Scoring & Maps: Full score input and flyover maps on your wrist.
- Game Modes: Stroke Play, Stableford and Side Games free; Match Play and team formats Premium.
- Shot Dispersion Tool: See where your shots are likely to land and pick smarter aim points.
- Auto-Change Hole: The app advances automatically as you move.
- Distance Arcs: Free in Course Preview only; Premium in-round.
- Notes & Highlights: Course strategy notes plus your career highlights.
- Ad-free experience.

INTELLIGENCE (Hole19's AI tier):
- Otto AI: Your personal AI caddie. Unlimited AI round reports that tell you exactly where you're losing strokes and what to work on.
- Auto Shot Detection: Track every shot with one tap after the round.
- Strokes Gai
